about.title: What RoadAtlas is
about.lead: RoadAtlas is a personal-first engineering roadmap and decision hub — a place to showcase, follow, track and revisit technology roadmaps.
about.mission: It answers two connected questions: what to learn or build next, and why a choice was made — keeping roadmaps, comparisons, findings and decision records in one connected view.

tdaim.title: Built on TDAIM
tdaim.subtitle: Theme- and Direction-Aware Incremental Model — the way this project is designed and grown, not just a label.

modular.title: Modular
modular.body: Responsibilities live in small, cohesive modules. The catalog, the map and the detail view each own their piece, so a change stays in one place.

incremental.title: Incremental
incremental.body: Every feature ships as a working vertical slice — roadmaps first, then the map and beyond — and each one extends the foundation instead of replacing it.

themeAware.title: Theme-aware
themeAware.body: Dark, light and ocean themes read from one set of semantic tokens, so a new theme never means rewriting a component.

directionAware.title: Direction-aware
directionAware.body: English (LTR) and Arabic (RTL) are first-class: layouts use logical properties and mirror without a separate stylesheet.

applies.title: How this site applies TDAIM
applies.subtitle: The details behind the four pillars, visible in the interface you're using now.

tokens.label: Semantic tokens
tokens.body: Components never hard-code colors; they consume CSS variables like surface, border and foreground, so themes stay consistent everywhere.

themes.label: data-theme switching
themes.body: A single data-theme attribute swaps the whole palette at runtime and the choice is remembered across visits.

i18n.label: i18next for every string
i18n.body: All interface text is externalized into English and Arabic locale files, with interpolation handled per language.

rtl.label: RTL by logical properties
rtl.body: Direction-aware spacing and icons flip automatically, so the Arabic layout mirrors the English one without bespoke overrides.

origin.title: Where it came from
origin.body1: RoadAtlas started as a conversation about choosing between React Native, Kotlin Multiplatform and Flutter — and the realisation that the honest story isn't the first impression but the hidden friction that appears as a project grows.
origin.body2: That framing — a learning curve alongside a complexity curve — became the seed for the app: capture the reasoning, the trade-offs and the findings, and keep them connected to the roadmaps and projects that produced them.

stack.title: The stack
stack.subtitle: A small, deliberately separated set of layers — one job each.

client.label: Client
client.body: Vite + React + TypeScript with Tailwind, React Router, TanStack Query, react-i18next and React Flow.

server.label: Server
server.body: Express + TypeScript + Mongoose with zod validation and JWT auth in an httpOnly cookie.

shared.label: Shared
shared.body: TypeScript domain types used by both client and server, so the contract lives in one place.

home.title: Build your path.
home.subtitle: A clear view of the technologies, roadmaps, and projects shaping what you’ll build next.

tdaim.title: TDAIM: Theme-Direction Aware Incremental Model
tdaim.body: TDAIM (Theme-Direction Aware Incremental Model) is a software engineering approach that keeps themes and reading direction as first-class concerns. By relying on semantic design tokens, logical CSS properties, and vertical-slice delivery, systems can grow incrementally without breaking existing surfaces or breaking LTR/RTL layouts.
